*.description: Unspecified runtime and workload values are analytical assumptions, not measured Huawei/Kimi performance.

model.architecture.description: Official Kimi K3 config and modeling_kimi_linear.py tensor dimensions. Text backbone only; local source snapshots and hashes in docs/sources.

model.reported_total_params.description: Rounded official 2.8T and 104B counts; used for comparison only, not rescaling derived tensor counts.

model.architecture.kda.state_dtype.description: FP32 recurrent state layout; validate dtype against deployed kernel.

model.architecture.kda.chunk_size.description: 64-token chunk boundary activation retention; runtime/kernel dependent.

model.architecture.kda.conv_state_tokens.description: Four allocated convolution samples; mathematical minimum is three.

hardware.npu_count.description: 64 NPUs per compute cabinet; this scenario is one cabinet slice of up to8192-NPU Atlas950, not the full domain.

hardware.su_size.description: The simulated SU contains one64-NPU slice; hardware maximum is8192, not64.

hardware.npus_per_host.description: Eight NPUs per modeled host; host grouping is not an official BOM.

hardware.topology.description: Full-mesh is a logical nonblocking fabric abstraction with shared endpoint injection; not a claim of physical all-to-all cabling.

hardware.npu.hbm_bytes.description: 950DT HiZQ2.0:144GB/chip. Here GB is explicitly interpreted as1e9bytes; source unit ambiguity retained.

hardware.npu.hbm_Bps.description: 950DT HiZQ2.0 nominal memory access bandwidth4TB/s; no measured sustained bandwidth supplied.

hardware.npu.flops.fp8.description: 950 series announced1PFLOPS FP8. Source does not specify dense/sparse condition; realized efficiency is assumed.

hardware.npu.flops.fp16.description: 0.5PFLOPS FP16 analytical placeholder; not supplied by cited source.

hardware.npu.flops.bf16.description: 0.5PFLOPS BF16 analytical placeholder; not supplied by cited source.

hardware.npu.flops.fp32.description: 50TFLOPS FP32 analytical placeholder; not supplied by cited source.

hardware.npu.efficiency.description: 50 percent effective compute efficiency; no calibration benchmark.

hardware.npu.runtime_bytes.description: 8GB runtime reservation per NPU, not actual framework allocator measurement.

hardware.npu.workspace_bytes.description: 256MB additional kernel workspace per NPU, beyond explicit component buffers.

hardware.scale_up.description: Official total interconnect2TB/s; model assumes1TB/s per direction and80percent efficiency. Source does not resolve directionality.2.1us is represented once per logical path.

hardware.cpu.description: 4TB DDR and512GB/s per modeled host;4TFLOPS CPU with50percent efficiency and1e8IOPS; illustrative host configuration, not Ascend950 BOM.

hardware.host_link.description: 64GB/s per direction shared by eight modeled NPUs per host,85percent efficiency,2us; requires actual host interconnect measurements.

hardware.scale_out.description: 400Gb/s=50GB/s per modeled host NIC per direction,80percent efficiency,5us; unused in this single-slice case.

execution.precision.description: Design reprecision of official model shapes, not the published MXFP4-routed/BF16 checkpoint; storage/compute/KV/activation are independent.

execution.parallelism.description: TP8 EP8 PP1 DP1. Dense/shared components replicate across EP; routed experts shard. Uniform routing; no production deployment trace.

workload.description: Fixed batch8,input128,output2; short smoke workload, not representative production SLO.

model.architecture.mla.cache_layout.description: Compressed MLA cache optimization study: retain 512 latent + 64 additional key elements per token/layer, replicated across TP. Official HF reference instead caches expanded K/V. Kernel compute/runtime is not calibrated to either layout.

hardware.calibration.description: Huawei Ascend 950DT / Atlas 950 64-NPU cabinet slice, based on public roadmap. Nominal chip HBM/FP8 fields sourced; topology direction interpretation, CPU/DDR/H2D/SO and efficiencies are unmeasured assumptions. See docs/sources/README.md.

assumptions: Ascend950DT/Atlas950 announced roadmap profile, not a measured installed platform.950DT Q4 2026 availability was stated in2025;2026MWC confirmed cabinet scale, not measured performance.

64NPUs are a cabinet slice inside an up-to8192-NPU design. All SI capacity/bandwidth values use decimalbytes; perchip144GB interpretation does not silently adopt inconsistent published1152TBaggregate.
Text backbone tensor counts are shape-derived, not rounded2.8T budgets. Vision encoder/projector and training MTP are excluded; published training report has1MTP but releasedconfig has0.
Official model uses SiTU-GLU, gated MLA and KDA+AttnRes; generic kernel timing, fused working sets and uniform expert routing remain uncalibrated.
Released checkpoint has MXFP4 routed experts with32-element groups anduint8scale; primaryFP8/FP16cases are controlled reprecision studies, not exact checkpoint storage.
Latency/throughput are analytical predictions, not Kimi production benchmarks. No queueing/continuousbatching/prefixcaching. TTFT begins after weights loaded.
Detailed productionK3 training uses MoonEP, virtualPP,PipelineZeRO2,activationoffload/remoteoffload andP2PMuon; genericFSdP/optimizer baseline does not reproduce those mechanisms.

MLA cache_layout=compressed is an explicit optimized cache assumption, not the official HF reference cache implementation. Compare expanded layout using examples/sweep_kimi_k3_kv_layout.yaml. NoPE skips positional encoding but retains the 64-dimensional key projection.
